headline: Contested Fronts Roar Across the Line
war_summary: Since the last edition, the sharpest movement has come in FishermansRowHex and WeatheredExpanseHex. Fishermans Row now records 34 events in 24 hours, including eight in the latest two, with Eidolo, Black Well, and Arcadia the busiest positions; its holdings remain six Colonial, one Warden, and two neutral bases. Weathered Expanse has climbed to 49 daily events and 11 in the latest two hours, with Frostmarch and Crow's Nest accounting for most of the action. StlicanShelf remains divided seven Warden, one Colonial, and one neutral, while five fresh events and accelerating enlistments keep its front live. MooringCounty has seen four events in two hours and rising casualty and enlistment rates, with ten Warden, one Colonial, and one neutral base still on the ledger. Stonecradle retains its five-to-four Warden-Colonial split after 12 daily events, though none arrived in the latest two hours. CallahansPassage's Crumbling Post action has gone quiet since its earlier exchange, while heavy losses there are cooling. No victor is declared.
